page_title: UNI 0-3 STU | Union Berlin v Stuttgart 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' A bullet header by Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the left post.
90+4' A dangerous looking corner kick from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is cleared to safety by the defence.
90+4' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+3' The resulting corner from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is cleared by the defence.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

88' 0 - 3 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Woo-Yeong Jeong is pounced on by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart). His close-range header flashes past Frederik Ronnow and into the right of the goal. 0:3.
88' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.

86' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) darts to the edge of the box to meet the ball from the free kick and sends a header towards the middle of the target. One of the defending players gets in its way and blocks it.
86' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. A free kick is awarded to Union Berlin.
84' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' The ball is cleared after Silas (VfB Stuttgart) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Stuttgart are going to take it.
83' Substitution. Dan-Axel Zagadou walks off the pitch and Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as a substitute.
82' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Enzo Millot.

81' 0 - 2 An amazing individual effort from Silas (VfB Stuttgart) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 0:2. Frederik Ronnow was helpless.
81' The referee signals a substitution. Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Robin Knoche.
79' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) blows a big chance to score! He slammed the ball from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it went narrowly over the crossbar.
76' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Frederik Ronnow scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
75' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
73' The Union Berlin players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
73' 4:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
69' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Chris Fuhrich and he is replaced by Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart).
69' Substitution. Jamie Leweling will be replaced by Silas (VfB Stuttgart).
67' Unlucky! Alex Kral (Union Berlin) hits a thunderous volley on the edge of the box that just flies over the bar.
66' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
63' Here is a change. Rani Khedira is going off and Urs Fischer gives the last tactical orders to Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin).
63' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots goalwards, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Frederik Ronnow. What a save!

59' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
58' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) commits a foul and Bastian Dankert immediately signals a free kick.
56' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing. The ball is out of play and Union Berlin manage to earn a corner.

55' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Corner kick. Union Berlin will have an opportunity.
53' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
51' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) was too forceful with his tackle and Bastian Dankert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
49' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
48' Bastian Dankert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart).
46' Urs Fischer has made a change at the break. Sheraldo Becker has come on in place of Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).
46' The game is over for Kevin Volland (Union Berlin). David Datro Fofana comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) will not participate anymore and Alex Kral is coming on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle and it's Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
43' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
41' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
40' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
39' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Bastian Dankert who sees an offensive foul.
39' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
37' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
36' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
34' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
34' Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
30' Serhou Guirassy is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart).
29' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Bastian Dankert saw the whole situation.
29' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
28' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alexander Nubel intercepts the ball.
26' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle. Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) commits a foul after dangerous play.
25' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
24' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
23' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
20' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
19' Stuttgart are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

16' 0 - 1 It's in! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the right of the goal after a cheeky lofted pass from Anthony Rouault. 0:1.
15' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
15' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off the line to clear the ball away.

14' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.

13' Robin Knoche (Union Berlin) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Bastian Dankert no option but to blow his whistle. Stuttgart are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
11' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
10' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
10' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
9' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
8' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
6' Bastian Dankert couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) and blew his whistle.
4' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Bastian Dankert blows for a foul.
4' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
3' Looks like Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
2' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) commits a rough foul. Bastian Dankert stops the game and makes a call.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Stuttgart will have the kick-off.
Bastian Dankert will officiate today.
